info.name: Floor / obstacle segmentation
info.description: Semantic segmentation (floor vs obstacle) for robot navigation. Decodes the run-box labels written by the Segmentation Labeler extension and trains a MobileNetV2 + LR-ASPP network with a FOMO-compatible output, so it deploys like FOMO.

parameters.name: Number of training cycles
parameters.help: Epochs. With a few hundred images, 60-100 is a good range.

parameters.name: Learning rate
parameters.help: Initial Adam learning rate; decays with a cosine schedule.

parameters.name: Backbone width
parameters.help: MobileNetV2 width multiplier. 0.35 is the fastest on the Arduino UNO Q CPU.

parameters.name: Obstacle threshold per cell
parameters.help: An output cell is trained as obstacle if at least this share of its labeled area is obstacle. Lower = more cautious.

parameters.name: Obstacle loss weight
parameters.help: Extra weight on obstacle cells: missing an obstacle costs more than a false alarm.

parameters.name: Data augmentation
parameters.help: Horizontal flips, zoom crops, lighting and noise. No vertical flips or rotation.

parameters.name: Output resolution
parameters.help: 1/8 matches FOMO and deploys through Edge Impulse. 1/4 is finer but not verified with Edge Impulse deployment.

parameters.name: Labeler classes
parameters.help: Class names in the Segmentation Labeler's order (Settings tab). Must match the extension.

parameters.name: Default class
parameters.help: The class the labeler never writes as boxes.

parameters.name: Label grid columns
parameters.help: Must match the labeler's grid (Settings tab).

parameters.name: Label grid rows
parameters.help: Must match the labeler's grid (Settings tab).
